# Getting help

For installation, start with the [README](../README.md#install). The guides
cover
[Sunshine and display setup](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/introduction/getting_started/host_setup),
[audio on macOS](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/guides/features/audio) and
[keyboard and controller shortcuts](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/automation/automation/shortcuts).

If something still does not work, search the
[existing issues](https://github.com/Se7enbrc/glimmer/issues) first. Open a bug
report with your Glimmer and macOS versions, Sunshine version, and the steps
that reproduce the problem. Include the display, audio output or controller
involved when relevant. For a feature request, explain what you want to do and
what gets in the way.

Performance telemetry is optional. For stutters, freezes or audio dropouts, the
[profiling guide](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/project/contributing_index/profiling#opt-in-telemetry)
explains how to record a session and mark the moment something goes wrong.
Review files before posting: they can include the streamed app and details of
your display and network setup, even though PC names and addresses are redacted
or replaced with short codes. Never attach keys, PINs, certificates or
provisioning profiles.

Report security vulnerabilities through
[GitHub's private report form](https://github.com/Se7enbrc/glimmer/security/advisories/new),
not a public issue. See
[the security policy](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/security-and-privacy/security).

Code changes start with an agreed issue. The
[contribution guide](https://ugfugl-io.gitbook.io/docs/project/contributing_index/contributing)
covers setup and the local checks.
